investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Unschedulable: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity on Swarm Cluster
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api at 2026-07-01T04:54–05:02Z with an identical Kubernetes scheduling error: the cluster's 6 nodes could not schedule the requested pod because only 2 nodes carry the kata.peerpods.io/vm resource and both are fully consumed, while the remaining 4 nodes do not match the pod's node affinity/selector. Because the pod never scheduled, the agent VM was never provisioned, and the eval runner produced zero evidence — all four required contract fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) are missing.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes scheduler reports "0/6 nodes are available: 2 Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm" — the two nodes that carry the kata peer-pods VM resource are at capacity and no preemption victims exist. The pod remains Unschedulable for ~139–145 s until the eval times out. Because the remote agent VM is never created, the runner's createAgent call (run-status-probes.mjs line 1885) never returns a VM ID or a ready state, so the evidence object stays empty and the expected-output contract for orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, and remoteState is entirely unmet. This is an eval-observed infrastructure capacity constraint, not a code defect; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.

Secondary — node affinity/selector mismatch on the remaining 4 nodes: the remote-agent pod spec requires a node label or taint that only the 2 kata-capable nodes satisfy; the other 4 nodes are structurally ineligible regardless of resource availability.
